interpretation: For a known member of this complete selected vocabulary, an ID absent from a sparse property_sets Boolean list is false because the mapped properties have complete coverage and are available. This negative inference does not apply to unknown IDs, incomplete datasets, or unavailable properties. The declared conflict groups mean mutually exclusive selections; no invocation rule is inferred from their names.

choices.name: Wrap long boolean chains
choices.description: Break a long short-circuit &&/|| chain across lines instead of one very wide line (whitespace only).

tier.name: Formatting
